Name: Kenneth's Fruit Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b][size=4]Kenneth's Fruit Shop[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Adds 254 fruits to Stardew Valley.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]What is inside[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]- 254 fruits like Ambrosia Jelly Fruit, Bartlett Pear, Berry Medley Fruit Bowl, Black Plum, Bright Yellow Lemon, Cantaloupe Melon, Cantaloupe Melon Slice and many more[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Fruit bowls, piles, slices and single fruits[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Some fruits have food buffs[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Building with 5 shop variants and portraits[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Every fruit can be turned on or off in GMCM[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Where to buy[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]All fruits are sold in Kenneth's Fruit Shop building. The building has 5 shops inside with different fruit selections.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Building Note[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Kenneth's Spacious Farm, Kenneth's Vast Farm, Kenneth's Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Content Patcher[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for toggling fruits[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]- DSS[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Works with most content mods.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Made by Kf29 aka Kenneth[/size][/b]
